videos.title: EWTN News In-Depth
videos.description: Roundtable discussions unapologetically examining and analyzing important issues and events from a strictly Catholic perspective.

videos.title: EWTN News Nightly
videos.description: Daily news and analysis, from Washington, D.C.

videos.title: Fathers for Good
videos.description: Fr. Francis Gustilo and Frank Padilla discuss the need to care for the poor in our communities and around the world; they conclude the series with a challenge to all men to follow the perfect will of God.

videos.title: Angels of God
videos.description: Fr. John Horgan presents the Church's comforting teaching on the wondrous life of the Angels of God. He relates that God has created these spiritual beings for our help and for his praise. See why spiritual formation with the angels is so powerful.

videos.title: At Home With Jim and Joy
videos.description: Dynamic husband and wife radio team Jim and Joy Pinto bring their powerful witness to daytime TV with special guests and topics focusing on marriage, family and pro-life issues.

videos.title: Savoring Our Faith
videos.description: Father Leo Patalinghug goes on the Rhine River Cruise Pilgrimage and explores the influence of Catholicism.

videos.title: The Holy Rosary With Mother Angelica
videos.description: Mother Angelica and the Poor Clares of Perpetual Adoration recite the Joyful Mysteries of the Rosary from the Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament in Hanceville, Ala.

videos.title: From the Heart, With Mother Angelica
videos.description: Mother Angelica talks about why some stay away from God, and how she can encourage them to return to church, encounter the saints, discover spirituality and come to know the divine indwelling as God living within them.

videos.title: Catholics Come Home
videos.description: Steve Ray recounts his journey from once convincing Catholics to leave their faith, to now being a renowned evangelist helping people come home to Jesus and the Catholic Church.

videos.title: EWTN Religious Catalogue
videos.description: Celebrate your faith as EWTN Religious Catalogue presents a unique array of religious items - from books and paintings to rosaries and statues - and everything in between.

videos.title: Saints of China: Martyrs of the Middle Kingdom
videos.description: Dr. Anthony Clark is joined by Fr. Paul Mariani, S.J. to discuss the challenges and triumphs of the Catholic Church in China today as it struggles and flourishes under Communist rule.

videos.title: The Chaplet of St. Michael
videos.description: Mother Angelica and the Nuns of Our Lady of the Angels Monastery ask for the intercession of the Prince of the Heavenly Hosts and the nine Choirs of Angels, as they pray the chaplet of St. Michael.

videos.title: Holy Land Rosary
videos.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa leads the Joyful Mysteries of the Rosary from the actual holy sites and shrines where they took place, bringing the Gospels to life and offering a deeper understanding of the Rosary meditations.

videos.title: The Litany of the Blessed Virgin Mary
videos.description: A beautiful prayer in honor of the Blessed Virgin Mary from the Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament in Hanceville, Alabama.

videos.title: Daily Mass
videos.description: The Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word celebrate the Holy Sacrifice of the Mass from the Our Lady of Angels Chapel in Irondale, Ala.

videos.title: Chesterton Station
videos.description: Chesterton and George Bernard Shaw face off in a showdown and learn more about life, faith and death.

videos.title: When Children Adore
videos.description: Father Thomas asks why John the Baptist said, "Behold the Lamb," when he introduced Jesus.

videos.description: Wendy and Duncan ignore the donut cookbook and create a new flavor that tastes so awful that the Donut Man has to close the shop; Fr. Joe teaches the kids why they must follow God's commandments and listen to His Word.

videos.title: My Catholic Family
videos.description: Thomas and Helen teach their children Alex and Sarah about the lives and charisms of the Catholic Church's greatest saints, in this delightful animated series that reconnects families and inspires children of all ages. After Sister Patricia teaches about St. Cecilia, Sergio and Martin forgive one another as she forgave her executioners, while Sara seeks her intercession before a big piano exam.
